page.overview:
What is Zacharias Smith?

Zacharias Smith (b. c.1979-1983) was a wizard who attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, who was Sorted into and a member of Hufflepuff House. He was a Chaser on the Hufflepuff Quidditch team and a member of Dumbledore's Army, an organisation taught and led by Harry Potter. On 2 May 1998, he abandoned the D.A. instead of fighting with them during the Battle of Hogwarts.

Ronald Weasley detested him as soon as they met, mostly because of his insolent and cynical attitude while talking to the trio, and his disloyalty towards Harry Potter and Hogwarts.

Zacharias was born into the Smith family, most likely between 1979 and 1981 in Great Britain or Ireland.

Zacharias probably started his education at Hogwarts in either 1992 or 1993. During the Start-of-Term Feast, Zacharias was Sorted into the house of Hufflepuff and it is possible he shared a dormitory with Ernie Macmillan, Justin Finch-Fletchley, and Wayne Hopkins. Zacharias did not fit the normal Hufflepuff archetype, as he showed selfishness, disloyalty, and cowardice, while most Hufflepuffs were loyal.
